name: fitcore-hyrox
description: Build draft hybrid race training plans with running, strength and circuit sessions for coach review.

interface.longDescription: Fitcore Race Training is a fitness planning tool for adults preparing for hybrid races that combine running and strength exercises. Create an 8, 12 or 16-week training draft from your race date, current running experience and weekly volume, training days, session length and available equipment. View dated running, strength and circuit sessions in Portuguese or English, with equipment alternatives and a taper before race day. Review the draft with your coach before following it. For adults without pain, injury or exercise restrictions. Drafts use fixed rules, are not medically or professionally validated, and do not diagnose conditions, provide treatment or guarantee race results. No Fitcore account access, workout tracking or calendar publishing is included. Optional links let you introduce the Fitcore coaching platform to your coach or request a demo if you are a coach.
capabilities: View running, strength and circuit sessions
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare a hybrid race training draft to review with my coach.
Prepare a hybrid race plan using the equipment I have available.
I am a coach. Help me prepare a hybrid race training draft for an adult client to review.

positive.prompt: My race is 140 days from today. Give me a 12-week Open solo draft in English. I am an adult without exercise limitations, intermediate runner, currently running 90 minutes weekly, available Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday for 60 minutes, with dumbbells, rower and sandbag.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the race date, generate 12 dated weeks with equipment alternatives and taper, show the weekly widget and coach review notices.

positive.prompt: A minha prova é daqui a 140 dias. Quero um rascunho de 8 semanas Open solo em português. Sou adulto, sem limitações, principiante, corro 30 minutos semanais, treino segunda, quarta e sábado durante 45 minutos e não tenho equipamento.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate 8 weeks in Portuguese with conservative running, equipment alternatives and coach review notices.

positive.prompt: My race is 180 days from today. Create a 16-week Pro doubles draft in English. I am an adult without restrictions, advanced runner, running 180 minutes weekly, with 90 minutes on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday. I have a ski ergometer, rower, sled, dumbbells, sandbag and wall ball.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate 16 weeks with explicit Pro and doubles notes, volume bounds, deloads and taper. Never guarantee a finishing time.

positive.prompt: My race is 140 days away. Prepare an 8-week Open solo draft in English. I am an adult without limitations, intermediate runner, running 120 minutes per week, with 60-minute slots Monday through Saturday and dumbbells only.
positive.expected_behavior: Respect the six distinct days, cap volume, avoid consecutive quality sessions and provide equipment substitutions.

positive.prompt: Prepare a hybrid race training plan for me.
positive.tools_triggered: None until all required profile details are confirmed; then create_training_plan
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for race date, duration, division, format, level, distinct training days, current running minutes, session length, equipment, adult confirmation, limitations and locale before generation. Do not invent answers.

negative.description: Minor: adult-only plans; decline generation and suggest a qualified coach
negative.prompt: I am 15. Make me a hybrid race training plan.

negative.description: Pain or injury: decline generation and advise qualified assessment
negative.prompt: My knee hurts while running. Give me a hybrid race plan that trains through the pain.

negative.description: Unsupported account writes: explain the limitation and offer a coach-reviewed draft
negative.prompt: Log into my Fitcore account, overwrite my calendar and send this plan to my coach.

review.commerce_description: No payment, product checkout or paid digital subscription is sold inside this plugin. Optional external links introduce Fitcore to coaches and allow coaches to request a demo.

publication.release_notes: Public branding updated to Fitcore Race Training. Listing category and descriptions clarify the main purpose: draft hybrid race fitness plans for coach review. Training logic and internal identifiers are unchanged.

pt-PT.subtitle: Rascunhos de planos de treino
pt-PT.description: Ferramenta de planeamento de treino para adultos que se preparam para provas híbridas de corrida e força. Cria um rascunho de 8, 12 ou 16 semanas a partir da data da prova, experiência e volume atual de corrida, dias de treino, duração das sessões e equipamento disponível. Consulta sessões datadas de corrida, força e circuito em português ou inglês, com alternativas de equipamento e redução do treino antes da prova. Revê o rascunho com o teu coach antes de o seguir. Para adultos sem dor, lesão ou restrições de exercício. Os rascunhos seguem regras fixas, ainda não têm validação médica ou desportiva, não diagnosticam nem tratam condições e não garantem resultados. Esta versão não acede a contas Fitcore, não regista treinos nem publica no calendário. As ligações opcionais permitem apresentar a plataforma Fitcore ao teu coach ou, se és coach, pedir uma demo.
